senses.gloss: m. (πρόθυρον; θ rendered by זד) verandah, vestibule.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Kings 7:7">Targ. I Kings VII, 7</cite> <cite ref="Q01706"><he>פרוסדא</he></cite> (ed. Lag. <he>פורסדא</he>; corr. acc.).—
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:16">Ab. IV, 16</cite> <he>העולם חזה דומה לפ׳ וכ׳</he> (Ar. <he>לפרוס׳</he>) this world is like a vestibule to the world to come; prepare thyself in the vestibule &c.

Cant. R. to IV, 12 בא וישב עליה בפ׳ he (the king) came and sat down in judgment over it on the verandah (in the sight of all people).—Trnsf. the forepart of female genitals, the lower end of the vagina or uterus.
<cite ref="Tosefta Niddah 3:9">Tosef. ib. III, 9</cite> <he>פרסדיר</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <cite ref="Q01659"><he>פרוזדור</he></cite>). Y. ib. II, 50ᵃ; a. e.
